decisions.reason: As a recently launched handle line close to the core business, it is likely to be retained because the firm has already committed design, tooling and marketing resources and can still view any weak early response as normal market ramp-up.
This multi-model door lever family sits squarely in the established portfolio, so its broader investment and visible commitment make management unlikely to withdraw it after only about a year.

Although a single door handle design is easier to prune than a larger family, it is still close to the firm's core offer and recent enough that management would likely justify keeping it on the market longer.
Like other new handle designs, it fits the firm's established competence and public product promise, so escalation of commitment points to continued support rather than a quick withdrawal.
Because this is another multi-model handle family in the firm's main business, the sunk development and launch effort and the firm's broad-range strategy both favor keeping it.
The electronic access system is not only close to the existing offer but also strongly aligned with the firm's stated move toward digital building organization, making withdrawal especially unlikely.
